title: R17 §4 nonauthor technical review record
description: Machine-checkable form of a technical review as OP-PROT-019-v1.1 (R17) §4 defines it. A record conforming to this schema is a VERDICT ON AN OBJECT. It carries no gate movement, no premise discharge and no organizational independence credit beyond the integer it states in independence_credit. Enforced by tools/reviews_check.py, which applies this schema plus the cross-record and cross-register rules the schema alone cannot express.

review_id.description: Identifier of this review record. Unique across reviews/records/.

route_key.description: The 'Review key' of the row in registers/json/review_queue.json this record answers. Must exist there verbatim.

review_utc.description: UTC instant of the substantive review activity. R17 §5: this is 'last substantive review activity', recorded separately from request time; it never resets review age by itself and it never approves anything.

object_id.description: Exact object identity: Drive file ID, carrier ID plus relative path, or repository path. Not a title, not a folder.

object_title.description: Title as it appears at the source. A title match is not an identity match (R17 §6).

object_bytes.description: Byte count of the exact reviewed body. Must be > 0 when obtained is true.

object_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact reviewed bytes, lowercase hex. Empty only when obtained is false.

extraction_rule.description: How the reviewed bytes were derived from the source: export MIME type, revision ID for native Docs, ZIP carrier member path, decode step. R17 §2: 'Native Docs require revision-aware extraction; Drive modifiedTime alone is not a body digest.'

obtained.description: True only if the reviewer actually read the exact bytes named above.

obtained_how.description: The concrete route by which the bytes were obtained, or, when obtained is false, exactly what was unobtainable and what was tried.

reviewer_family.description: Organization family of the reviewing session, lowercase (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai'). Provider, not model name.

reviewer_session.description: Reviewer session identity. R17 §4 requires 'author and reviewer session/provider', which the CONTRIBUTION_PLAN §5 summary omits.

author_family.description: Organization family of the object's author/coauthor lineage, lowercase. Use 'unknown' when the lineage is not established; 'unknown' forbids any independence credit.

author_family_determination.description: How author_family was determined: the register column, the body's own attribution line, a Work Events row, or the fact that it could not be determined.

exposure_disclosure.description: R17 §4 'It must disclose source exposure'. What this session had already read of this object, its predecessors, successors, consumers and register rows before the review began, and what of that could have shaped the verdict. Long-form and specific; boilerplate is rejected by the checker.

hypotheses.description: The precise hypotheses the object's statement is conditional on, as stated by the object, one per entry.

reconstruction.description: The reconstructed argument in the reviewer's own words, step by step, from the read bytes. R17 §4: 'A source search or hash match alone is not mathematical review.'

negative_controls_executed.description: Each executed control, what defect it would have caught, and whether it fired. May be empty ONLY with a non-empty negative_controls_not_applicable_reason (R17 §4 'if applicable').

negative_controls_not_applicable_reason.description: Why no negative control applies to this object. Required to be non-empty when negative_controls_executed is empty.

execution_performed.description: The 'meaningful execution' or counterexample search R17 §4 asks for alongside reconstruction, if any: what was run, on what input, with what result.

findings.description: Findings by criterion, as R17 §4 requires. An empty list is allowed only when the reviewer genuinely found nothing under any criterion checked.

unresolved_dependencies.description: Named dependencies still open after this review: premises, lemmas, missing drivers, unresolved heads.

technical_verdict.description: Exact-object correctness verdict, from the register's own R17 status set and nothing else.

scope_dependency_verdict.description: The separate scope/dependency verdict R17 §4 lists as its own dimension: what scope the object's statement actually covers and whether its declared dependencies hold. Distinct from technical_verdict.

independence_credit.description: Organizational independence credit awarded by this record. 0 for a same-family reviewer (R17 §4: 'Same provider is zero organizational independence'). This session is Anthropic-family, so every record here carries 0.

independence_reason.description: Why that credit and no more, naming the predicate (OP-PROT-012 §5 / R17 §4) that licenses it.

independence_evidence.description: Required non-empty only if independence_credit is 1: the documented OP-PROT-012 §5 (a)-(j) evidence.

gate_status_after.description: The state of every gate, premise and obligation after this record exists. Always UNCHANGED. A technical review is a verdict on an object; it does not move a gate.

does_not_establish.description: Explicit statement of what this record does NOT establish. Must be specific to this object; boilerplate shared with another record is rejected by the checker.

reproducible_output.description: Commands, script paths or receipt references by which a third party can reproduce this review's output.

sha_mismatch_explanation.description: Required non-empty when object_sha256 differs from the 'Body SHA-256' the review_queue row carries for this route_key: which bytes were reviewed and why they differ (successor version, different extraction rule, register hash stale).

notes.description: Free text. Scanned for promotion language like every other free-text field.
